title: Parallel Matrix Painting
instructions: Implement `paint_quadrant` and `divide_and_paint` in `config/imagePainter.py`. `paint_quadrant` fills a half-open rectangle of the matrix in place. `divide_and_paint` splits the matrix into four quadrants, submits one task per quadrant to a `ThreadPoolExecutor`, and waits for all of them so any worker exception reaches the caller.

evidence.label: Paints the four quadrants of an even matrix
Paints every cell exactly once for odd and degenerate sizes
paint_quadrant fills only its half-open region, in place
Quadrants run concurrently on executor worker threads
Waits for a slow quadrant before returning
Propagates a worker exception to the caller
